attributes.board_name: Iowa Board of Behavioral Health Professionals (Department of Inspections, Appeals, and Licensing)

rules.accepted_credit_types: Workshops, conferences, symposiums, webinars and independent study meeting board criteria; academic courses (1 semester hr = 15 h); max 20 h combined for presenting, research, publications, teaching, board service
rules.new_licensee_rule: No CE required for the first renewal; hours from initial licensure to the second renewal may be used. Licensed within 6 months of the renewal date: no renewal until the next cycle.
rules.carryover: Up to 50% of excess CE may be carried into the next biennium.
rules.audit_note: A percentage of licensees is randomly audited after each renewal cycle; keep certificates (title, dates, hours, sponsor, name) for 4 years.

topics.who: Licensees serving in a supervisory role
Licensees who examine, attend, counsel or treat children in Iowa: HHS mandatory reporter training (2 h initial; renewal attests completion within previous 3 years)
Licensees who examine, attend, counsel or treat adults in Iowa: HHS dependent adult abuse mandatory reporter training within previous 3 years

rules.notes: CE compliance period is 25 months: Sept 1 of even year to Sept 30 of next even year; license period Oct 1 even year to Sept 30 next even year. Board does not pre-approve providers.
rules.rule_quote: Each biennium, each person who is licensed to practice as a mental health counselor or marriage and family therapist in this state is required to complete a minimum of 40 hours of continuing education that meets the requirements of this chapter.
